channel.title: Dad Joke of the Day
channel.description: A fresh dad joke every day. Get the app at dadjokes.vip

item.title: What do elves make sandwiches with?
item.description:
What do elves make sandwiches with?
Shortbread!

item.title: The customer said 'Do you serve crabs here?'
item.description:
The customer said 'Do you serve crabs here?'
Yes Sir,' said the waiter 'we serve just about anybody!'

item.title: What did the hungry computer eat?
item.description:
What did the hungry computer eat?
Chips one byte at a time!

item.title: What do polar bears eat for lunch?
item.description:
What do polar bears eat for lunch?
Ice berg-ers!

item.title: Waiter, will my pizza be long?
item.description:
Waiter, will my pizza be long?
No sir, it will be round!

item.title: What do you call a scary bear?
item.description:
What do you call a scary bear?
A grisly grizzly.

item.title: What do you call a discounted boat ride?
item.description:
What do you call a discounted boat ride?
A sail sale.

item.title: How do you catch a fish without a fishing pole?
item.description:
How do you catch a fish without a fishing pole?
With your BEAR hands.

item.title: What do you call strawberries playing the guitar?
item.description:
What do you call strawberries playing the guitar?
A jam session!

item.title: Why couldn't the sesame leave the casino?
item.description:
Why couldn't the sesame leave the casino?
Because he was on a roll!
